description:
Storyhouse are delighted to present a spacious and modern 2 bedroom apartment at Saint Edmunds Avenue, Lucan. This newly built apartment comes fully furnished and comprises of an open plan living and kitchen area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a utility room. Your standard of living at Saint Edmunds is enhanced by the inclusion of on-site amenities, which include an on-site building manager, co-working and lounge facilities and a gym. Saint Edmunds Avenue offers convenience in a popular area, all within easy reach of Dublin City Centre, complete with plenty of excellent transport links, close proximity to the M50, and well-established local schools, supermarkets, shopping centers and facilities. Liffey Valley Shopping Centre and Retail Park all within walking distance. Photos are for illustrative purposes only and the layout my differ depending on type.
